description:
Share market, trading aur personal finance, 45 second ke animated Shorts mein, Hindi mein. SEBI ki study ke hisaab se 93% F&O traders ne 3 saal mein paisa gawaya. The 7% Club batata hai kyun, aur baaki 7% kya alag karte hain.
शेयर बाज़ार, ट्रेडिंग और पैसों की समझ, आसान हिंदी में।

Aap kya seekhenge:
• Trading psychology: revenge trading, FOMO, stop-loss ki galtiyan
• Option trading basics: time decay, leverage, expiry day ka risk
• India mein investing: SIP, mutual funds, index funds, compounding
• Money traps: credit card, EMI, BNPL, lifestyle inflation
• Scam red flags: Telegram tips, fake profit screenshots, "guaranteed returns"
• Tax basics: new tax regime, STCG vs LTCG

Roz naye Shorts: subah 8:30 aur shaam 7:30 baje (IST).

📌 Sirf educational content. SEBI-registered nahi. Investment advice nahi.
